notes.title: Curated community levels list
notes.content:
From now on you have a community level list in the game, 
where you can select the extra levels you want to play.

Hope you like them!

Cheers

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
- Update colission effects
- Update force fields particles effects
- update default zoom in 
- Also more and updated community levels

notes.title: Fix Bug
notes.content:
Previously, Steam didn’t track how much time you spent playing the game, and it would always reinstall it.
Now, it's just a single executable file, and it works on Steam as intended.
